statusDetail: Coverage-complete audit of the public AMP listing, search, error state, and manifest. External media/detail destinations and account/commercial flows were not covered.

page.notes: Server-rendered adult-content listing with a required age gate. Detail links leave amp.xnxx.com.

paths.description: Homepage/listing and age gate at desktop/mobile/preferences; representative search listing; explicit 404 recovery; manifest. Excludes external detail/media destinations and commercial/account flows because they leave this AMP host or return a bare 404.

findings.summary: Dark theme preference is ignored
findings.evidence: Dark-mode screenshot is pixel-identical to the default capture; computed root color-scheme is normal and authored CSS has no prefers-color-scheme rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Add color-scheme: light dark and theme tokens selected with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Reduced-motion preference is ignored
findings.evidence: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, authored CSS has no reduced-motion query while the AMP startup stylesheet defines an 8-second visibility animation.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable the AMP startup animation and any non-essential transitions under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

findings.summary: High-contrast preferences are not supported
findings.evidence: Under prefers-contrast: more, authored CSS has neither prefers-contrast nor forced-colors handling; controls retain the same fixed blue palette.
findings.suggestedFix: Add forced-colors and prefers-contrast adaptations that preserve control and text visibility.

findings.summary: Cross-document state changes are abrupt
findings.evidence: The listing and search are separate document states, but authored CSS contains no site-defined view-transition names or cross-document transition rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Use @view-transition { navigation: auto } with a reduced-motion fallback for same-origin listing/search navigation.

findings.summary: Long listings provide no scroll-position guidance
findings.evidence: The long 29,784px mobile listing has static header chrome and no authored scroll-state query or progress affordance.
findings.suggestedFix: Make the compact header respond to scroll state or add a lightweight progress/return affordance.

findings.summary: Page structure and orientation cues are missing
findings.evidence: The page has no h1-h6 headings and 100 of 311 controls lack a computed accessible name, weakening orientation and attention cues. The rendered document contains no headings and only a header landmark; focus styling is a minimal 1px browser outline.
findings.suggestedFix: Add one descriptive h1, logical section headings, main/nav landmarks, descriptive labels, and robust focus-visible styles.

findings.summary: Age gate lacks dialog semantics
findings.evidence: The required age gate is implemented as fixed div-based chrome rather than a dialog element with modal semantics and managed focus.
findings.suggestedFix: Implement the required gate as a modal dialog with an accessible name, focus containment, and explicit legal exit/recovery behavior.

findings.summary: Reusable cards respond only to the viewport
findings.evidence: Reusable video cards adapt only through viewport media queries; authored CSS contains no @container rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare a card-grid container and adapt cards with size container queries where they are reused.

findings.summary: Many controls are too small and focus is weak
findings.evidence: The probe found 107 visible controls below 24px in at least one dimension and the focused link had only a 1px auto outline.
findings.suggestedFix: Give interactive controls at least 44px touch space where practical and a high-contrast :focus-visible indicator.

findings.summary: Largest Contentful Paint needs improvement
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 3.3s (needs improvement), while CLS was 0 and TBT 30ms; the trace measured LCP 1.83s in a separate run.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP thumbnail/logo, reduce blocking CSS/font work, and verify LCP below 2.5s.

findings.summary: Render-blocking and cache delivery delay content
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 46 requests/955,886 bytes, a render-blocking Font Awesome stylesheet, and many thumbnails without cache headers; Lighthouse estimated 910ms render-blocking savings. AMP scripts were confirmed async.
findings.suggestedFix: Inline critical icon styles or replace the icon font, cache thumbnails, and keep noncritical resources deferred.

findings.summary: Unused and duplicate code is shipped
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 18KiB unused CSS and 32KiB unused JavaScript and flagged duplicated JavaScript.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unused Font Awesome/AMP payload and eliminate the duplicate JavaScript identified by coverage.

findings.summary: Media links and images lack accessible names
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed image-alt and link-name; the image probe found 28 of 31 images missing alt, and 100 of 311 controls were unnamed.
findings.suggestedFix: Give each thumbnail image useful alt text or connect its link to the visible card title; hide decorative duplicates.

findings.summary: Dense 12px typography harms legibility
findings.evidence: The mobile capture and computed CSS show a 12px body base and dense metadata across a very long listing, reducing reading comfort.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase the body/metadata type scale and spacing, and use legible line-height and wrapping on narrow screens.

findings.summary: Mobile zoom is disabled and targets are small
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found user-scalable=no in the effective viewport meta and the control probe found 107 small controls; zoom is therefore blocked despite overflow-free reflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove maximum-scale/user-scalable=no and enlarge small controls without sacrificing reflow.

findings.summary: AMP configuration throws runtime errors
findings.evidence: Lighthouse captured repeated console errors and uncaught exceptions from AMP CLIENT_ID configuration.
findings.suggestedFix: Correct the CLIENT_ID invocation/configuration and verify a clean console in production.

findings.summary: Responsive image delivery is unsound
findings.evidence: Doctype/UTF-8 are valid, but Lighthouse failed responsive image sizing and the image audit found no srcset on all 31 rendered images.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide appropriately sized responsive candidates and preserve explicit intrinsic dimensions/aspect ratios.

findings.summary: Generic link text and disabled zoom reduce crawl/mobile quality
findings.evidence: Links use href and robots permits the page, but Lighthouse found two generic HERE link texts and the effective viewport disables scaling.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace HERE labels with destination-specific text and allow user scaling.

findings.summary: Listing lacks structured and share metadata
findings.evidence: The content listing exposes no JSON-LD and no Open Graph properties, so individual listing/share context is not represented in structured or social metadata.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate Open Graph metadata and suitable schema.org JSON-LD for the listing or represented entities.

findings.summary: Defensive response headers and cookie posture are weak
findings.evidence: HTTPS and CSP are present, but CSP permits unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval, HSTS and nosniff are absent, and the session cookie uses SameSite=None. Headers inspection found no HSTS, Permissions-Policy, or nosniff; X-Frame-Options is SAMEORIGIN, while Referrer-Policy remains no-referrer-when-downgrade.
findings.suggestedFix: Add HSTS, nosniff, a restrictive Permissions-Policy, tighten CSP away from unsafe directives, and avoid SameSite=None unless required.

findings.summary: The page has a broad cross-origin data surface
findings.evidence: HAR classified 43 of 46 requests and 930,696 of 955,886 transferred bytes as cross-origin; tracker scan found seven third-party origins, though none matched its known-tracker list.
findings.suggestedFix: Inventory cross-origin endpoints, self-classify owned CDNs, remove unnecessary partners, and minimise/batch analytics and identifiers.

findings.summary: Bidirectional and logical-layout readiness is partial
findings.evidence: html lang=en is present, but dir is omitted and authored CSS still contains 15 physical left/right declarations alongside some logical properties.
findings.suggestedFix: Set dir appropriately and replace physical left/right declarations with logical inline/block properties.

findings.summary: Images are not responsively or efficiently delivered
findings.evidence: All 31 images use legacy PNG/JPEG, all lack srcset, 20 below-fold images are not lazy, and Lighthouse estimated 119KiB image-delivery savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Use AVIF/WebP where effective, srcset/sizes, intrinsic dimensions, and lazy loading below the fold.

findings.summary: Third-party/font/media bytes are disproportionate
findings.evidence: The listing transfers about 956KB before media playback, including 930KB cross-origin and 183KB of icon fonts; 20 below-fold thumbnails load eagerly.
findings.suggestedFix: Subset or replace icon fonts, defer below-fold thumbnails, and enforce a per-template third-party/media budget.
